article.title: Useful phrases for starting a meeting
article.description: Common professional openers: 'Shall we get started?', 'Let's dive right in.', 'Thanks everyone for making the time.', 'I'd like to run through today's agenda.' Register: professional but not overly formal — appropriate for most workplace meetings. Avoid overly casual openers like 'What's up guys' in a professional context.

slides.headlineRest: — Professional Ways to Open Your Meeting
slides.body: Starting a meeting effectively sets the tone. Phrases like 'Shall we get started?', 'Let's dive right in,' or 'I'd like to run through today's agenda' are perfect for professional workplace meetings. They convey readiness and respect for everyone's time without being overly formal. For instance, you might say, 'Thanks everyone for making the time; let's dive right in.' Remember to avoid overly casual openers like 'What's up guys' in a professional setting to maintain appropriate decorum.
